build_get_credentials: build AWS boto3 credentials from access keys, session tokens, role ARNs, or web identity tokens with caching
build_sign_request: build and sign a POST request for Bedrock or SageMaker API calls using AWS SigV4 authentication
build_get_request_headers: build signed HTTP request headers for AWS Bedrock runtime API calls with SigV4 or bearer token auth
build_get_bedrock_invoke_provider: build the provider name from a Bedrock model path like anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0
build_get_bedrock_model_id: build the canonical model ID from optional params and provider-specific model path specs
